title: test/apply-migrations.js: Migration Setup
description: Applies D1 migrations to the test database using cloudflare:test API, safe to run multiple times as only unapplied migrations execute.

steps.description: Imports: applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test, env from cloudflare:workers.
Safety: comment noting idempotency - only unapplied migrations run.
Execution: await applyD1Migrations with env.DB and env.TEST_MIGRATIONS.
